newsitem.title: ITALY: Italian bond futures close with pared losses.
newsitem.headline: Italian bond futures close with pared losses.

text.p: 1600 GMT - Italian bond futures pared earlier losses to close easier weighed down by the lack of progress on pay talks between metalworkers and employers and as Italian wage inflation rose to 4.5 pct in Nov after Oct's 3.7 pct. Metalworker talks set to restart on Jan 3. Support came from steady lira and rally on T-bonds after U.S. data. LIFFE closed early at 1232 GMT.
* Bonds:June +3bps at 108.66, yield 7.59 percent, spread vs 10-yr bund 180bp
* Futures:Mar LIFFE -5bps at 128.25. Mar MIF -10 bps at 128.47.
* Lira: 983.60/4.60 vs mark after 983.00 Tuesday afternoon
